prompts.text: What's the funniest way someone has tried to cheer you up after a long day?
Tell me about an unlikely person who became your regular source of encouragement.
Your best friend is allowed to choose your motivational slogan for a week. What do you think they'll pick?
A friend sending surprise memes or dropping off your favourite snack?
A thoughtfully chosen silly message sometimes works better than generic advice.
Some people show care through quiet practical favours rather than grand declarations.
Which small gesture tells you somebody knows how to read your mood?
Recall somebody helping you through a problem with a surprisingly entertaining idea.
A friend needs a morale boost before a difficult conversation. What's a playful way to encourage them?
A ten-second pep talk from a friend or a note filled with inside jokes?
What little habit do you share with someone without remembering how it started?
Describe a friendship ritual born from a completely accidental moment.
Your group has to invent a weekly greeting without using words. What would it look like?
Make a secret handshake or create a shared catchphrase with a friend?
A friendship tradition becomes more meaningful when nobody tries to make it impressive.
Even friends who live apart often retain the tiny habits they formed years ago.
Which friendship ritual would sound odd if you explained it to a stranger?
Tell me about meeting someone after years apart and instantly falling into an old routine.
A close friend wants to retire an inside joke you've used for years. What should replace it?
Recreate an old tradition faithfully or invent a new version each year?
Which person do you trust to tell you when you're being unintentionally dramatic?
Recall a time somebody pointed out one of your quirks and you laughed in agreement.
Your friends assemble a harmless instruction manual for spending time with you. What appears on page one?
Have friends roast your playlist choices or your tendency to overpack?
Gentle teasing works best when everybody has the same freedom to opt out.
People often exaggerate familiar habits as a way of expressing closeness.
Which personal quirk would your friends describe more accurately than you would?
Tell me about a friend who turned one of your habits into a nickname you liked.
You have to defend your most unusual social habit in a playful debate. What's your argument?
Be the friend who narrates everything or the one who constantly invents sound effects?
What's an unexpected lesson you've learnt from somebody much older than you?
Describe a cheerful conversation that bridged a big age gap.
A younger relative challenges you to teach each other a favourite childhood game. Which game comes first?
Exchange slang from different generations or compare old-fashioned dating advice?
A little curiosity makes conversations across generations more entertaining than stereotypes.
People from different age groups sometimes share the same humour through different references.
Which piece of advice from an older person sounded odd before it made sense?
Recall teaching somebody older a modern shortcut and learning something from them in return.
A grandparent and a teenager must choose the music for a party together. How might they negotiate?
Hear a grandparent's funniest youthful adventure or a teenager's strangest school trend?
What's the most amusing way a neighbour has started a conversation with you?
Tell me about recognising someone through their routine before learning their name.
Your building hosts a friendly competition between households. What harmless event would you suggest?
A neighbourhood recipe swap or a shared outdoor board-game afternoon?
You don't have to know every detail about your neighbours to enjoy being friendly.
People sometimes become familiar faces long before they become friends.
Which everyday place has introduced you to people you now know by name?
Describe a helpful exchange with a neighbour that turned into a friendly tradition.
The people on your street organise a welcome event for newcomers. What would make it relaxed?
Meet neighbours while gardening or during an informal tea break?
Which quality would make somebody a brilliant travel companion for a group?
Recall the person who kept everyone laughing during a delayed journey.
Your travel group must elect a chief navigator who gets lost easily but tells great stories. Who gets nominated?
A friend who researches every stop or one who finds unexpected places along the way?
A travel companion who stays pleasant during disruption matters more than perfect organisation.
Trips reveal which friends are calm planners and which enjoy improvising.
What's the funniest harmless disagreement you've had about what to pack for an outing?
Tell me about being unexpectedly paired with someone who turned out to be great company.
Two friends want to photograph every stop, while the others want to keep moving. What's a fun compromise?
Have a designated group photographer or let everyone contribute their favourite snapshot?
When someone you like is unusually quiet, what do you do before drawing conclusions?
Describe a moment when a conversation went better after you stopped trying to fill every silence.
A friend attends a party but wants a quiet corner. How would you help without making a big announcement?
Sit together without talking or take a gentle stroll and see what comes up?
Being good company doesn't require having a new story every five minutes.
Some people are at their funniest once they're comfortable enough not to perform.
Which friend appreciates quiet companionship more than big gatherings?
Tell me about a relaxed afternoon with someone when you barely noticed the time passing.
Your group decides to host an evening without phones or loud music. What would everyone do?
Share comfortable silence over coffee or exchange one thoughtful question each?
Which social courtesy do you wish more people treated as normal?
Tell me about a time someone corrected a misunderstanding with good humour.
A friend accidentally takes your reserved seat at an event. What's the friendliest way to mention it?
Give someone a gentle private reminder or use a humorous signal you've agreed beforehand?
Clear invitations save more awkwardness than elaborate social hints.
People sometimes mistake an enthusiastic tone for agreement when the details still need discussion.
What's a polite way of declining an invitation without giving a long explanation?
Recall being pleasantly surprised when someone accepted your refusal without argument.
Someone regularly brings an unannounced guest to small gatherings. How should the host approach the subject?
Receive a clear invitation a week early or a casual invitation on the day?
What's the most endearing habit you've noticed in a couple you know?
Describe a time two friends supported each other through a harmless disagreement.
You have to invent a light-hearted prize for good teamwork between two people. What would it reward?
Share an interest with a partner or enjoy having separate hobbies to discuss later?
The way two people handle minor inconveniences says plenty about how they cooperate.
Every pair of close people develops small signals outsiders rarely notice.
Which simple shared responsibility makes two people feel like a team?
Tell me about a pair of relatives whose everyday friendship you admired growing up.
A couple wants a date with no big spending and asks their friends for ideas. What would you suggest?
An affectionate nickname or a shared annual tradition?
What's one funny prediction a friend once made about who you'd become?
Recall a person who encouraged you to try something outside your usual interests.
Your friends create a playful yearbook entry for the adult you are today. What's the funniest category?
Ask a childhood friend to describe how you've changed or let a newer friend guess your old habits?
A good friend notices growth without insisting you remain the person they first met.
People often show a different version of themselves in every stage of a long friendship.
Which quality in somebody close to you has grown more noticeable with time?
Tell me about a friend whose unexpected change inspired you to try something new.
You meet your closest friend ten years from now. What's one change you'd hope to celebrate?
Keep an old photo with friends on your wall or plan a new photo at the same location?
